[모멘텀 지표]
· RSI 궤적 (57.2→52.2) + 중립 구간 지속 + 하락 방향성 확인
· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (716.9177→1356.5256) + 개선 진단 + 추세 전환 신호 미약

· 스윙 저항선 (279,000원) + 돌파 시 상승 전환 기대

analysis.narrativeEn:

· Position relative to SMA100 (280,881 KRW) / SMA200 (224,656 KRW): suggesting potential shift to weaker mid-to-long term trend.
· 52-week position (63.4%) + current price level at historical mid-range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (57.2→52.2) + continued neutral range + confirmation of downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (716.9177→1356.5256) + improving trend + weak signal for trend reversal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band 263,300 KRW) + band width at 15.77% indicating expansion.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support level (246,000 KRW) + based on rebound from low.
· Swing resistance level (279,000 KRW) + expectation of upward reversal upon breakout.

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + entry conditions: RSI exiting oversold below 45 confirmed, MACD histogram turning positive and sustained, volume exceeding 1.2x.
